notes: GUESS. Primavera has published the day split only. Stages and times are predicted from the poster's font sizes and the PS24 and PS26 grids (scripts/data/ps-history.json). Wednesday and Sunday's stage is unknown, so they sit on a single Parc del Fòrum stage. Replace with the real timetable when it lands.

sets.name: Fades
sets.why: Smallest name on the night and local, so it opens: PS26's Wednesday opener slot.

sets.name: Mushka
sets.why: Local rap-pop name, second up as Wednesdays build from local to international.

sets.name: CHVRCHES
sets.why: Sunset slot before the headliner; PS26 gave it to Guitarricadelafuente.

sets.name: Underworld
sets.why: Top of the free day. PS26's Wet Leg and PS24's Phoenix both closed around 23:05.

sets.name: Guillem Gisbert
sets.why: Catalan singer of Manel. The Estrella opener is a local act most years (Aiko el Grupo, Mujeres, Ferran Palau).

sets.name: Wallows
sets.why: Line-3 guitar pop with a young crowd: the first Revolut hour, like Blood Orange in PS26.

sets.name: Turnstile
sets.why: Line 2, but the hardcore act of the five: an hour at dusk leaves the night to the dance and pop names.

sets.name: Robyn
sets.why: Sunset pop slot (Alex G in PS26, Little Simz on Saturday); she takes a singalong hour before the big two.

sets.name: Massive Attack
sets.why: Darkness-dependent visuals, so first full-dark Estrella slot. Same slot they had in PS26.

sets.name: Fontaines D.C.
sets.why: Top of the bill: the 23:35 Revolut slot is the longest on the day (Doja Cat, PS26).

sets.name: Bad Gyal
sets.why: Local pop star, late main stage. Same slot as PS26.

sets.name: Viva Belgrado
sets.why: Spanish post-hardcore: Occident's first slot goes to a local band (Raly, Somos la Herencia).

sets.name: Underscores
sets.why: Line 3, online pop with a large young draw: Geese's PS26 slot.

sets.name: Pavement
sets.why: Biggest Line-3 name and a Primavera institution, so the prime hour on the mid stage. Mac DeMarco's PS26 slot.

sets.name: Kim Petras
sets.why: Late pop on Occident once Fontaines ends, the TV Girl and Jade slot.

sets.name: Brutalismus 3000 b2b Isoxo
sets.why: Hard club crossover for the 03:00 Occident slot (Overmono, Viagra Boys).

sets.name: Jersey
sets.why: Line 4, couldn't identify the act: the first Cupra slot is the low-risk place for it.

sets.name: Greg Freeman
sets.why: US indie rock suits the early Cupra slot Men I Trust had.

sets.name: Metrika
sets.why: Spanish trap, Sónar-tested and billed on Line 3: Cupra's 20:50 usually goes to a Spanish rising act (Ralphie Choo, rusowsky).

sets.name: Metronomy
sets.why: Long Cupra set after Massive Attack. Father John Misty's slot.

sets.name: Snow Strippers
sets.why: Detroit electronic duo for the crowd leaving Fontaines. Runs alongside Bad Gyal, a different audience.

sets.name: Joy Orbison
sets.why: DJ closer: Cupra's 04:30-06:00 always goes to a selector.

sets.name: Axolotes Mexicanos
sets.why: Spanish indie pop opening the smallest open-air stage, the slot for domestic small-print names.

sets.name: Alemeda
sets.why: US R&B and rap, early evening.

sets.name: Haute & Freddy

sets.name: Sophia Stel
sets.why: British pop songwriter opposite Massive Attack and Pavement, for those not going to either.

sets.name: Gilla Band
sets.why: Noise rock late, in the Schwarzkopf slot after midnight.

sets.name: Castle Rat
sets.why: Doom-heavy spectacle, the late heavy slot (Kylesa, Fcukers).

sets.name: Blaya
sets.why: Club-pop for the last Schwarzkopf hour.

sets.name: Tristán!

sets.name: Friko
sets.why: Chicago indie rock, Port's early-evening guitar slot.

sets.name: Westside Cowboy
sets.why: British indie on the sea stage at sunset.

sets.name: EAR
sets.why: Line 4, couldn't identify the act, but it's on Porto's bill too, so a fair draw: Port's prime slot.

sets.name: Blackhaine

sets.name: Dame Area

sets.name: Tatyana Jane
